original_semantics.period_counts: scheduled_sessions counts all supplied governed sessions whose civil date lies within exact selected period; completed_sessions counts those with actual close<=C. Both depend on full causally admitted calendar proof, not price delivery, and can remain ready while period OHLC is missing. Current-period price aggregation uses only eligible sessions/prefix<=C, never future daily prices. A current period may contain supplied known future schedule definitions for scheduled count; they are calendar knowledge, not market observations.
original_semantics.period_completion: prior_complete requires entire selected period end_date_exclusive<=target_date and all selected regular sessions completed. current_to_cutoff uses completed earlier DAILY plus optional target BAR prefix only. A current-prefix at C=regular_open is an explicit no-observation contribution, no fake zero-width batch. Earlier covered period sessions still aggregate normally.
original_semantics.phase_zero_prefix: C<phase_start: selected extended values all null/not_applicable/no_eligible_observations. C=phase_start: no market batch permitted; explicit mathematical zero-prefix branch gives volume/notional0 available expected=observed0, prices/returns null/not_applicable/no_eligible_observations, using actual calendar proof only. No InputScope(start,start). C>phase_start uses actual positive-duration canonical batch scope.
original_semantics.anchor_cutoff: Require start<C. start=C or start>C -> typed ContractError BOUNDS. Positive-duration complete empty batch -> volume/notional0, VWAPnull/not_applicable/zero_denominator. Missing market delivery -> missing_input, never zero.
original_semantics.anchor_proof: Proof declaration admits exact supplied mathematical anchor; it does not authenticate selection history or claim a breakout algorithm computed the anchor. Threshold/policy-derived anchor selection remains EF8.
original_semantics.path_open: Use same complete canonical path batch to derive opening witness. TRADE: first eligible price under exact auction policy. BAR: first positive-volume bar.open, while samples are its completed closes. No duplicate cloned BAR IDs or separate hidden open scalar. Whole path prefix starts actual regular open.
original_semantics.gap: G=O-P; remaining=max(0,(last-P)/G); fill=max sampled clamp((O-x)/G,0,1); filled exists (x-P)*G<=0; first_fill timestamp first eligible hit. G0 makes all four gap-specific outputs not_applicable/zero_denominator. No hit -> first_fill null/not_applicable/no_eligible_observations, filledFalse available. OHLC low alone is never a sampled close hit.
original_semantics.drive: Completed window[regular_open,open+duration), final sampled return last/O-1, up=max(0,maxsample/O-1),down=max(0,1-minsample/O). Trades at window end excluded, completed bars ending there admitted. No private strength threshold or episode state.
original_semantics.action_quantity: apply_factors expects actual raw representation and actual raw_shares source basis; output policy may request split_shares and accepted utility transforms explicitly. caller_transformed expects actual caller_transformed and source quantity exactly requested output quantity basis. Gates do not apply factors and do not add a dividend twice. A requested transformed split-share output does not imply incoming raw volume was already split-adjusted.
